contracts.statement: A record admitted by a batch connector is a pinned byte-exact external assertion: its identity is content-derived, its bytes are sha256-pinned inside an intake bundle, and it names the source bundle it came from.
contracts.prediction: Every record of this class passes the mechanical checks declared here, and a batch over N artifacts closes the count identity fetched == admitted + quarantined + conflicts with zero silent drops.
contracts.falsifier: Mutating exactly one field of one record (or one byte of one pinned artifact) must quarantine exactly that record, close the count identity, and refuse admission of the corrupt class; a second full run must create zero objects and reproduce the graph hash byte-identically.

contracts.statement: A measurement record admitted by a batch connector carries a finite SI value with named units, conditions of applicability, and the same pinned-byte provenance as the entity class.
contracts.prediction: Every measurement passes the entity-class checks plus finiteness and unit-vocabulary checks; no NaN or unitless number ever enters the graph through a batch.
contracts.falsifier: One non-finite value or one unit outside the declared vocabulary must quarantine exactly that record and refuse the class batch.

contracts.statement: A Smithsonian 3D geometry candidate is a CC0-licensed, millimetre-metric specimen derivative: units mm, a positive bounded bounding box, and the exact GLB bytes pinned by sha256 inside the intake bundle.
contracts.prediction: Both USNM 15259 derivatives (cranium, mandible) admit with units mm, bounded boxes in the 1-500 mm range, and their pinned GLB sha256 recorded; any derivative without a pinned blob is quarantined.
contracts.falsifier: A derivative with units other than mm, a non-positive or >500 mm box extent, or a missing/mismatched GLB pin must quarantine exactly that record.

contracts.statement: A Copernicus GLO-30 tile property names the pinned tile artifacts (DEM, EOXML, WBM, EULA) it was read from and a value inside the dataset's own declared envelope (1.0 arcsec postings, 0.1 m vertical quantization, metres/degrees units).
contracts.prediction: Every tile property admitted by the connector passes with units inside {m, degree, arcsec} and values inside the source-declared envelope; the h=H+N EGM2008 datum law is carried as provenance text, not silently applied.
contracts.falsifier: A property whose value falls outside the declared envelope, or whose artifact pin does not match the pinned tile bytes, must quarantine exactly that record.

contracts.statement: A PanTHERIA 1.0 species row keeps its full MSW05 identity tags (order, family, genus, species, binomial); a trait cell holding the -999 sentinel in ANY numeric rendering (-999, -999.0, -999.00) or an empty cell is nodata, recorded as an explicit trait status plus an explicit unknown on the species record, never as a numeric value.
contracts.prediction: All 5,416 species rows admit as entity records whose binomial agrees with their genus+species tags; the 20 sentinel-BMR Macaca rows carry explicit nodata unknowns while the one measured Macaca (Macaca mulatta) also resolves against the NCBI taxdmp Macaca subtree companion.
contracts.falsifier: A record whose binomial disagrees with its genus+species tags, whose trait_status value falls outside {measured, sentinel_-999, empty}, or in which a sentinel number appears where a status belongs must quarantine exactly that record; the -999 sentinel never reaches a measurement record of this source.

contracts.statement: A PanTHERIA trait measurement carries a positive finite SI value -- adult body mass in kg (g x 1e-3, exact) or basal metabolic rate in W converted as mLO2hr x 20.1 J/mL O2 / 3600 s with the calorific equivalent DECLARED as an assumption on every record, never as a PanTHERIA measurement -- plus full species tags and pinned-byte provenance.
contracts.prediction: 3,542 adult-mass and 573 BMR records pass with values inside [1e-6, 1e6] (measured extremes: 1.96 g to 1.54e8 g mass, 6.12 to 113,712 mLO2/hr BMR = 0.034 to 635 W); the sole measured Macaca BMR (Macaca mulatta) converts to ~12.50 W and carries the calorific assumption.
contracts.falsifier: A -999 sentinel reaching a measurement record refuses the class: the adapter guard must quarantine the row before drafting, and if that guard is ever removed the converted sentinel (-5.58 W or -0.999 kg) is negative, outside [1e-6, 1e6], and must be flagged by field_range for exactly that record.

contracts.statement: An NCBI taxdmp Macaca-subtree taxon record names its integer tax_id, its parent tax_id, a rank inside the subtree vocabulary, and exactly one scientific name, with every other name-class record (synonyms, authorities, common names) retained verbatim.
contracts.prediction: All 43 subtree taxa (root genus Macaca, tax_id 9539) admit with ranks inside {genus, species, subspecies, no rank} -- the no-rank entries being unclassified sections and isolate placeholders -- and every PanTHERIA Macaca binomial resolves against these names.
contracts.falsifier: A taxon whose rank falls outside the vocabulary, whose scientific name is missing or non-unique, or whose projected names disagree with the pinned subtree bytes must quarantine exactly that taxon's record.

contracts.statement: A Rhea rhea-chebi-smiles.tsv row maps exactly one CHEBI identifier to one SMILES string under CC BY 4.0 with the license evidence pinned inside the same bundle; a CHEBI id with competing SMILES rows has all of its rows quarantined by the duplicate-identity law, never a greedy pick.
contracts.prediction: The 14,318 headerless two-column rows reduce to 14,249 unique-CHEBI records with the remaining rows quarantined as duplicate identities; every admitted record declares its identity scheme as chebi and the count identity still closes.
contracts.falsifier: A row whose CHEBI id is not CHEBI:<digits>, whose SMILES is empty, or whose id competes with a different SMILES must quarantine exactly those rows with zero silent drops.
